# Releases

SmartFill Lite ships as a Chrome-compatible Manifest V3 extension. The app README links to its Chrome Web Store listing; no automated publishing workflow was found in the inspected repository.

From this app, `bun run build` regenerates theme CSS and creates `build/chrome-mv3-prod`. `bun run package` packages the extension using Plasmo; the README documents `build/chrome-mv3-prod.zip` for Web Store submission. Treat store submission as a separate publishing action; these scripts do not document an automatic store upload.

For local inspection, load the production directory through the browser's Extensions page with Developer mode enabled. Validate changes with the app typecheck, relevant Bun tests and production build. Use the local browser harness for fixture coverage, and separately verify installed-extension permissions and configured provider/voice behavior where relevant.

Release ownership, version/tag policy and issue tracker are unconfigured in the evidence gathered; do not invent them.
